interview.title: Health questions
interview.description: We will ask about your problem, your symptoms, your past illnesses and the medicines you take. Your answers are saved for your doctor.

sharePhysician.title: Sharing with your doctor
sharePhysician.description: Everything you tell us is shown to the doctor who treats you at this hospital.

documents.title: Your old papers
documents.description: You may show old prescriptions, lab reports or discharge papers. We read them and arrange them by date for your doctor.

abdmPush.title: Saving to your ABHA health record
abdmPush.description: We can save a summary of today's visit to your national ABHA health record, so any hospital can see it later. You may say no to this.

audio.interview: This section asks your permission for us to ask you questions about your health. We will ask what problem brought you here, how long you have had it, what other illnesses you have had, and which medicines you take. Your answers will be saved and shown to your doctor. You may stop at any time.
audio.sharePhysician: This section asks your permission to show everything you tell us to the doctor who will treat you at this hospital. This helps the doctor understand your problem before you go in, so your time with the doctor is used well.
audio.documents: This section asks your permission to look at any medical papers you have brought, such as old prescriptions, laboratory reports, or hospital discharge papers. We will read them, pick out the important details, and arrange them by date for your doctor. This is optional. You may say no and still see the doctor.
audio.abdmPush: This section is optional. It asks whether we may save a summary of today's visit to your A B H A health record, which is your national health record. If you agree, any hospital in India can see this visit in future. If you say no, your information stays only with this hospital.
